facts.text: Physics-based simulation is the most mature simulation family for lidar.
facts.quote: Physics-based simulation is the most mature family for lidar.

facts.text: The common core of physics-based lidar simulation is ray tracing with the actual scan pattern, beam divergence and timing, followed by a return-power and detection model.
facts.quote: The common core is ray tracing with the actual scan pattern, beam divergence and timing, followed by a return-power and detection model

facts.text: High-fidelity physics-based lidar simulation adds wavelength-dependent surface reflectance, multiple returns, receiver threshold and dynamic range, background light, range and intensity noise, and atmospheric propagation.
facts.quote: high-fidelity versions add wavelength-dependent surface reflectance, multiple returns, receiver threshold and dynamic range, background light, range and intensity noise and atmospheric propagation.

facts.text: Haider et al. built a tool-independent ray-traced lidar model incorporating the scan pattern and full signal-processing chain, packaged as an ASAM OSI/FMI unit.
